info.title: stare.pub static files
info.summary: The static files behind stare.pub, for resolving U.S. case law citations with plain GETs.
info.description:
Every path here is a static file on object storage or the site's static assets. Nothing computes a response: there are no query parameters, no keys and no server-side search. Resolving a citation is three GETs: the index manifest (`getManifest`), the volume's index (`getVolumeIndex`), and the case file it names (`getCapVolumeZip`). `https://stare.pub/llms.txt` has the recipe in prose, and `https://stare.pub/reporters.json` (`getReporterMap`) maps a reporter abbreviation to the slug the paths use.

The hosts: `idx.stare.pub` serves the citation index, `data.stare.pub` the case files, and `stare.pub` the site and the files describing the rest. Files under `v/<version>/` on the index host and the case files never change once published. Only the root manifest and the report history change, when an index build goes live.

CORS: `idx.stare.pub` and `data.stare.pub` send `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` only to stare.pub and its previews, so a browser page on another origin can't read them. A client that isn't a browser page isn't affected.

Licences: the Caselaw Access Project case files on `data.stare.pub/cap/` are CC0 1.0 (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), under the terms CAP published them with. Everything else the project produces, including the citation index, the index manifest and build reports, the reporter map, this document and the schemas, is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0/), with stare.pub (https://stare.pub) as the source. The reporter map's names, variations and editions come from Free Law Project's reporters-db (https://github.com/freelawproject/reporters-db), and the citare data bundle's reporter and court tables from reporters-db and courts-db (https://github.com/freelawproject/courts-db); those parts are under their BSD 2-Clause licence, which reporters.json's `sources` and the bundle's sidecar (`/data/citare/v1/citare-data-<hash>.json`) give with each source's commit and copyright notice. The CourtListener records under `data.stare.pub/cl/` aren't published yet; each will carry, in `license`, the Public Domain Mark 1.0 (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/) CourtListener puts on its bulk data, and in `attribution` credit CourtListener (Free Law Project) and the export it came from. The index manifest, build reports and report history state their licence in `license` from the first index build written with it. `info.license` is this document's.

get.description: Names the live build (`version`, and `base`, the path its files are under) and lists every volume the index holds by reporter slug. Fetch it first and build every index URL from its `base`. It changes when a new build goes live, so revalidate it after a minute.
The same as the root manifest for that build, without `base`: its files are next to it. Never changes.

Gzipped UTF-8 text, served as `application/gzip` with no `Content-Encoding`, so the client gunzips it. One line per case: `page,source,ref`.

- `page`: the case's first page, a number or a page label lowercased (`xxix`).
- `source` `cap`: `ref` is the case file in the volume's zip (`0647-01`, read as `json/0647-01.json`). A ref with a folder (`138-2/1012-01`) is in that folder's zip. A ref with a reporter (`neb/128/0783-01`) is a case in another volume, followed by `key=value` fields; `via=cl:<cluster>` means CourtListener's citation metadata linked it. Parse the fields from the end of the line, since case files can hold commas.
- `source` `cl`: `ref` is `<cluster_id>/<hash>`, a CourtListener record on data.stare.pub (none are published yet).

Lines that share a page are in order; the first is the case cited. Skip blank lines, lines starting with `#`, and sources you don't know. A volume split past 1,000 lines starts with `#parts,<first page of part 1>,<first page of part 2>,...`; a page at or past part n's first page is in part n (`getVolumeIndexPart`).

The volume is the number as cited, never a split folder's name (`138`, not `138-2`). A volume the manifest doesn't list returns 404.

parameters.name: part
parameters.description: The part number, 1 or more, from the position of its first page in part 0's `#parts` header.

get.summary: A later part of a split volume's citation index
get.description: Same format as part 0, without the `#parts` header.

get.summary: Every published index build's report totals

get.description: Counts by reporter and every volume that failed or was let through with a known reason. Several megabytes.

parameters.name: folder
parameters.description: The volume's folder: the volume number, or the folder an index ref names (`138-2`).

get.summary: A Caselaw Access Project volume's case files
get.description: The volume's zip as CAP published it: `json/<ref>.json` is a case (name, decision date, citations, court, jurisdiction, and `casebody.opinions` with each opinion's type, author and text), `metadata/CasesMetadata.json` lists every case with its first and last page, and `html/` has the cases as HTML. Typically 1 to 2 MB. Range requests work, so a client can read the zip's central directory from the end and fetch one case's bytes. Sent with ETag and Last-Modified and no Cache-Control; the file never changes.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: A byte range, to read part of the zip.

206.description: The requested bytes of the zip

Content-Range.description: The bytes sent and the zip's size, `bytes 0-99/422856`.

get.summary: How to use stare.pub, for language models and agents
Reporter abbreviations to slugs, with volume ranges and URL templates
get.description: `abbreviations` maps every edition name and variation citare knows (`A.2d`, `A. 2d`) to the slugs the index and case paths use. `reporters` gives each slug's names, editions, the volumes the index held when the site was built, and whether CAP has it. `urls` has the URL templates. Generated from the citare data and the index manifest at each site build; the live manifest stays the authority on which volumes are held.

The site's pages, with the date each last changed
Every site release, as an Atom feed

version.name: version
version.description: An index build's data version, the manifest's `version`. The manifest's `base` is `v/<version>/`.

slug.name: slug
slug.description: A reporter's slug: a key of the manifest's `reporters`, or of `reporters` in reporters.json (`A.2d` is `a2d`, `F. Supp. 2d` is `f-supp-2d`).

volume.name: volume
volume.description: The volume as cited: a number, or a year for year-volume neutral citations (`2019-Ohio-1234` is `ohio` volume `2019`).

CacheShort.description: `public, max-age=60`: changes when an index build goes live.

CacheImmutable.description: `public, max-age=31536000, immutable`: never changes once published.

CacheRevalidate.description: `public, max-age=0, must-revalidate`: changes with each site release; revalidate with the ETag.

ETag.description: The file's entity tag, for conditional requests.

NotFound.description: No such file: a volume or build the index doesn't have. For a volume, check the manifest first; a citation into a volume it doesn't list has no case on stare.pub.

Manifest.description: An index build's manifest, format 2 (crates/stare/src/manifest.rs in the stare source).

version.description: The build's data version, `vYYYY.MM.DD`, with `.N` for a later build the same day.

generated_at.description: When the build's manifest was written, RFC 3339 UTC.

base.description: Where this build's index files are, relative to the manifest (`v/v2026.10.18/`). Only the root manifest has it; without it the files are next to the manifest.

idx.description: 1 when the build has the `.idx.gz` files `getVolumeIndex` serves.

reporters.description: Slug → the volumes held, by folder: usually the number, plus `-2` and the like for a volume CAP split over folders.

parts.description: Slug → volume number → its folders with the page range each covers, for volumes CAP split. The ranges can overlap; try each folder whose range holds the page.

aliases.description: Slug → volumes whose `.idx.gz` holds only aliases into cases other volumes hold. They aren't in `reporters`.

license.description: The licence the build's files are published under: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, with stare.pub as the source. Absent from manifests written before it was added.
